en.tagline: Pick a City. Let AI Tell Its Story.

en.lmEmpireText: Jerusalem’s grand Ottoman portal in pale limestone, welcoming pilgrims and travellers since 1538.
en.lmChryslerText: Terraced public gardens and splash fountains connecting the ancient ramparts to the living city.
en.lmOneWorldText: The ancient stone citadel guarding the western ridge, uniting Herodian towers and Ottoman minarets.
en.lmCentralParkText: Historic Romanesque twin domes and rotunda preserving centuries of faith and pilgrimage.
en.lmTimesSquareText: Monumental Herodian golden limestone ashlar wall, sacred heart of prayer and whispered devotion.
en.lmFlatironText: The gilded octagonal sanctuary crowning the plateau with turquoise tiles and golden brilliance.
en.lmRockefellerText: Silver-lead dome and columned congregational hall set amidst centuries-old stone pines.
en.lmVesselText: Panoramic terraced ridge of ancient olive groves, looking across the Kidron Valley to the golden city.

zh-CN.lmEmpireText: 宏伟的奥斯曼浅色石灰岩城门，自1538年起迎接着四方朝圣者与旅人。
zh-CN.lmChryslerText: 阶梯式梯园与喷泉，将古老城垣与生机盎然的现代城市温柔相织。
zh-CN.lmOneWorldText: 守卫西侧山脊的巍峨古石城堡，融汇了希律巨塔与奥斯曼宣礼塔。
zh-CN.lmCentralParkText: 古老的罗马式双穹顶与明亮圆堂，见证着千百年来的朝圣与守护。
zh-CN.lmTimesSquareText: 巨大的希律时期金色石灰岩石墙，低语祈愿与心灵寄托的神圣中心。
zh-CN.lmFlatironText: 高踞山巅的鎏金八角圣殿，流淌着青绿釉彩与金色光辉。
zh-CN.lmRockefellerText: 银灰铅包穹顶与多柱式礼拜大殿，静静伫立于古老石松之间。
zh-CN.lmVesselText: 布满古老橄榄树的壮阔山脊，隔着汲沦谷遥望整座圣城的光芒。
